baseline.method: Executed original AIAgent.run_conversation and its forwarded conversation_loop modules unchanged under CPython, following tests/agent/test_run_agent.py fixtures. Original OpenAI-client I/O receives the fixed SDK-shaped replies in each input. model_tools definitions and dispatch use explicit fixture schemas and a constant tool-result string, separating loop behavior from independently verified real tools.
fixture_boundaries: System prompt fixed to You are helpful.; context files, memory, compression, background review, prompt caching and trajectory saving disabled.
Tool discovery and dispatcher stubbed; persistence, trajectory-saving and task cleanup are no-op fixture boundaries. No original loop branch or helper is replaced.
Explicit provider-client creation returns fixture clients; a virtual time object advances the original retry waits. No real provider or model request is made.
Not a live-model quality test, full CLI/product equivalence test, or real tool-I/O trajectory test. These raw records include original metadata and diagnostics.
comparison_scope: Compare final text, completed/failed/partial, logical API counts and usage, semantic messages and requests, tool-call IDs/names/arguments and tool results.

Exclude wall time, timestamps, generated session/turn/message IDs, internal persistence markers, provider call_id/response_item_id sidecars, schema descriptions and provider/transport default request options.
Concurrent tool start/completion ordering is not deterministic; preserve the raw dispatch log but compare dispatch identity/arguments in transcript call order.
